key_events.text: Candidate filing closed: 6 mayoral candidates (12 in 2022). Benes, Eštočák, Hagyari, Oľha repeat runs; Mochnacký and Pavlovičová first-time.
Mestská volebná komisia registered all 6 candidates.

Oľha campaign centred on investments and defending city borrowing ('Ako v meste šetríme cez úvery'); dispute with Mochnacký over council constituency resolution that Oľha refused to sign citing legality.
Oľha campaign released its 2nd commissioned NMS poll (12-16 Oct, n=510): Oľha 46, Hagyari 30, Mochnacký 11, Benes 5, Pavlovičová 5, Eštočák 4.
Denník N: Hlas and Republika endorse no Prešov mayoral candidate; cites older Policy Insights/Focus data Oľha ~24, Hagyari ~17, Mochnacký ~1, undecided >27.

notes: Coalition map 2026: governing Smer+SNS+Sme rodina+Bratia Slovenska back Pavlovičová; Hlas has NO mayoral candidate in Prešov (Hlas runs own council list; Hlas's Micheľ got 11.65 % in 2022) and, per Denník N (15.10.), Hlas and Republika endorsed no mayoral candidate - where Hlas voters go is a key unknown. Opposition split: PS+Demokrati+DS back incumbent Oľha; KDH+SaS+Hnutie Slovensko+KÚ+Za ľudí+Nova back Mochnacký (in 2022 SaS backed Oľha and KDH ran Bednárová 5.63 %). Hagyari (2nd in 2014/2018/2022) runs as NEKA this time (2022 STANK+Sme rodina). Markets: all bookmakers make Oľha a heavy favourite (1.08-1.10); Mochnacký has overtaken Hagyari as 2nd favourite at Tipsport by 20.10 and on Polymarket. Polls: only a sponsor-released NMS poll (12-16 Oct, n=510: Oľha 46, Hagyari 30, Mochnacký 11) and an older Policy Insights/Focus figure (Oľha ~24, Hagyari ~17, Mochnacký ~1, undecided >27) - both put Hagyari, not Mochnacký, 2nd, contradicting the late market move to Mochnacký. Hagyari is running for the 6th time (2nd in last three). Turnout 2022 42.66 %, 2018 43.2 %. Relative majority, one round: fragmented field (6) means winner can win with ~35 %.

key_events.text: City election commission registered 6 mayoral candidates (first time equal number of men and women). Bročka (mayor since 2014) not running.

Ľubica Horváthová (Demokrati) withdrew in favour of Eva Nemčovská citing internal polls; PS (MP Jana Hanuliaková) declared full support for Nemčovská; Horváthová aims to be vice-mayor if Nemčovská wins. They differ on the Medziháj development.
Trnava University sociology poll published: Baroš 32.4 vs Nemčovská 31.9 (statistical tie) before Horváthová's 12.4 % was released.

notes: Open seat (Bročka retiring after 3 terms; won 2022 with 44.7 % vs Baroš 33.62 %). Two-horse race Baroš (Trnava pre každého + KDH) vs. vice-mayor Nemčovská (NEKA, backed by PS and after 9.10 by Demokrati). Poll pre-withdrawal: 32.4 vs 31.9; if Horváthová's 12.4 % transfers mostly to Nemčovská she leads clearly - bookmakers price her favourite (1.45-1.65) vs Baroš (1.90-2.45). Pullmann carries Smer+Hlas+SNS+Republika label in a liberal-leaning city (2018 Smer+SNS candidate Válek got 5.77 %). Horváthová stays on ballot - votes for her invalid. Whether Bročka endorsed anyone: not found (SME: 'his shadow felt over every candidate'). Turnout 2022 41.87 %, 2018 37.74 %.

key_events.text: Richard Rybníček (mayor since 2010, 72.94 % in 2022) announced he will not run again; he backs his first deputy Ján Forgáč.

Commission registered 4 mayoral candidates, all NEKA; 5th filer Anton Kysel (SLOVEXIT) dropped after his party revoked the nomination. Council: 78 candidates, PS+SaS+KDH+Demokrati+OKS+Hnutie Slovensko joint list of 21, Hlas 5, Smer/SNS/Republika 2 each.

notes: Open seat after 16 years of Rybníček. Effectively Forgáč (continuity, Rybníček-endorsed) vs Mičega (two-time runner-up with ~27 %, the anti-Rybníček pole). No party formally nominates any mayoral candidate; no Smer/Hlas mayoral candidate, so where government-leaning voters go (likely Mičega?) is unknown - no source found on party endorsements. Birošová (withdrew in favour of Mičega in 2018 and 2022) stays in this time, splitting the opposition vote. No public poll found. Bookmakers: Forgáč 1.10-1.19, Mičega 4.0-6.0. Turnout 2022 37.0 %, 2018 42.03 %. Mičega's 27 % ceiling was vs. a popular incumbent; open-seat dynamics are different.

key_events.text: Fiabáne officially announced third (and, he says, last) candidacy as NEKA with support of PS, SaS, KDH and Demokrati. Long-running conflict with council member Cibulka (Fiabáne called him a 'hoaxer and troll') over Karpatská hall / Žilinská parkovacia spoločnosť land swap.
Commission registered 8 mayoral candidates (7 NEKA + Michal Milo for Republika).

notes: Incumbent Fiabáne (48.06 % 2018, 45.53 % 2022) faces fragmented field of 7. Main challengers: Johanes (doctor, ŽSK councillor) and Cibulka (3rd in 2022 with 15.51 %). In 2022 the 2nd place Groma (Hlas+KDH, 19.01 %) - this time KDH backs Fiabáne and Hlas/Smer/SNS/Domov run joint council lists but NO mayoral candidate; no source found on whether they informally back Johanes. Republika (Milo) is the only party-nominated challenger. Odds drifted from Fiabáne 1.04 / Johanes 7.0 (12.8.) to 1.18-1.20 / 3.8-4.0 (mid-Oct) - tightening but Fiabáne clear favourite. No scientific poll found (komunalne-volby.sk runs a self-selected web vote - not usable). Turnout 2022 38.16 %, 2018 41.3 %.
